abstract: Force LLM output to match a JSON schema, regex, choice list or grammar with guided decoding. Covers exact flags and request shapes for vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, TensorFold and ExLlamaV3/TabbyAPI, the xgrammar, guidance, outlines and llguidance backends, schema-subset limits, and a validity and accuracy quality gate with rollback. References hold the per-engine matrix and the gate; a probe script checks a constraint end to end.
